title: Patient River
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Woke up with the sunrise in my pocket
Your laughter lingers in the hallway

[Chorus]
Hold the night, don't let it go
We are golden in the afterglow

[Verse 2]
Your laughter lingers in the hallway
Woke up with the sunrise in my pocket

[Chorus]
Hold the night, don't let it go
We are golden in the afterglow

[Outro]
Forever in this melody
